say:1:1910528001:1.text: I thought you'd never wake up.
say:1:1910528001:1.source_cn: 哟，咱还以为你醒不过来了。
say:1:1910528001:1.male: I thought you'd never wake up.

say:3:1910528002:1.text: If you'd stayed in bed any longer, I was gonna knock on your skull and hammer you awake.
say:3:1910528002:1.source_cn: 你要是再躺下去，咱都准备敲你的脑壳，把你一锤子砸醒。

say:4:1910528005:1.female: But for real, it's good to see you awake... Yeah, it's good...

say:5:1910528006:1.text: Anyway... umm... my Waterstrider still needs work, and I need a hand. We're the only two landfolk here, and those finned folk don't know their own strength... you get me?
say:5:1910528006:1.source_cn: 咱那水行器还需要改进呢，需要人手，这地方就咱们两个陆地...

say:12:1910528013:1.text: The tentacle guy said that when the glowing tide came welling up from the Deepsea, he was on his way here with his brother. He saw those Deepfolk walk into that light and just vanish.
say:12:1910528013:1.source_cn: 触手男说，光从深海涌来的时候，他正带着弟弟往这里赶。他...

say:13:1910528014:1.text: After that, he ran toward Coralia like a madman. Before you cut that light off from the city, he and his brother managed to break through into the city.
say:13:1910528014:1.source_cn: 他发疯一样往塔拉萨冲，总之，在你把那种光隔绝在塔拉萨外...

say:19:1910528020:2.text: Same as you two. I picked up him and Garnet too and brought them home! They're staying in Tolan's room.
say:19:1910528020:2.source_cn: 和你们一样，我把他和歌尼特也“捡”回家了！他们住在图澜...

say:20:1910528021:1.source_cn: 你怎么站起来啦？多躺几天嘛，饭在餐桌上，我给你拿进来！

say:26:1910528027:1.text: That's just how it is when you're living in a big family! You only find it strange because you've been on your own too long. Don't worry, I'll come chat with you more often!
say:26:1910528027:1.source_cn: 在大家庭里生活就是这样啦，你一个人待太久才会不习惯。放...

choice:23:0:1.text: I want to ask Calix what the glowing tide really is.

choice:23:0:1.male: I want to ask Calix what the glowing tide really is.

choice:23:1:2.source_cn: 我想见见那对“海产兄弟”

choice:21:0:1.text: A little exercise can help you recover.
choice:21:0:1.male: A little exercise can help you recover.
choice:21:0:1.female: A little exercise can help you recover.

say:29:1910528022:1.text: That's great to hear! Grandma says that as long as someone has an appetite, their health should be okay. An old song says, "The more you eat, the faster the heartbeat..."
say:29:1910528022:1.source_cn: 太好了！阿嬷说，人只要还愿意吃饭，健康就不会出问题。老...

say:31:1910528018:1.text: They all swarmed him at once, and the tentacle guy didn't even fight back. I reckon even if there'd been three more of him, he still couldn't have gotten away. That's the good thing about the Shallowfolk; they always help each other out.
say:31:1910528018:1.source_cn: 他们一拥而上，触手男也没反抗，咱觉得就算再来三个他也逃...

choice:11:0:1.text: Oh right, I saw Calix before I fell asleep.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 对了，我睡着前看到了卡律！
choice:11:0:1.male: Oh right, I saw Calix before I fell asleep.
choice:11:0:1.female: Oh right, I saw Calix before I fell asleep.

say:33:1910528012:1.text: The tentacle guy and that freakishly big crazy sidekick of his. They're both here.
say:33:1910528012:1.source_cn: 触手男，还有他那个大得出奇的疯狂小弟，他俩都在。
say:33:1910528012:1.male: The tentacle guy and that freakishly big crazy sidekick of his. They're both here.
say:33:1910528012:1.female: The tentacle guy and that freakishly big crazy sidekick of his. They're both here.

say:34:1910528008:1.text: Ridiculous! I've never worried about anyone in my life!
say:34:1910528008:1.source_cn: 笑话，咱没担心过任何人！
say:34:1910528008:1.male: Ridiculous! I've never worried about anyone in my life!
say:34:1910528008:1.female: Ridiculous! I've never worried about anyone in my life!

choice:6:1:2.text: Admit it. You were worried about me.
choice:6:1:2.male: Admit it. You were worried about me.
choice:6:1:2.female: Admit it. You were worried about me.

say:35:1910528009:1.text: Ugh, you're so clingy! Stop talking.
say:35:1910528009:1.source_cn: 噫，真黏糊！你还是别说话了。
say:35:1910528009:1.male: Ugh, you're so clingy! Stop talking.
say:35:1910528009:1.female: Ugh, you're so clingy! Stop talking.

choice:2:0:1.text: What kind of talk is that?!
choice:2:0:1.male: What kind of talk is that?!
choice:2:0:1.female: What kind of talk is that?!

say:36:1910528003:1.text: Lying in bed all day makes your fur go moldy. I'm doing you a favor.
say:36:1910528003:1.source_cn: 一直躺床上毛会发霉，咱这是在帮你。
say:36:1910528003:1.male: Lying in bed all day makes your fur go moldy. I'm doing you a favor.
say:36:1910528003:1.female: Lying in bed all day makes your fur go moldy. I'm doing you a favor.

choice:2:1:2.text: You're the one who just shouted me awake...
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 刚才一嗓子喊醒我的就是你
choice:2:1:2.male: You're the one who just shouted me awake...
choice:2:1:2.female: You're the one who just shouted me awake...

say:37:1910528004:1.text: You bet. Don't let my short stature fool you. I'm stronger than you, you puny human!
say:37:1910528004:1.source_cn: 那可不，别看咱个子矮，身体可比你强，瘦弱的人类！
